summary: Iteration 9 — Script Engine 3.0 polish verification. All 5 UI polish requirements verified end-to-end against the live preview with the drcharitycampbell DEV_BYPASS account. Mode-pill active state, sprint/multi-platform mutual exclusion (incl. CTA copy variants and platform-card auto-hide), sprint vs non-sprint Send-to-Studio visibility, per-section data-section accent attribute, section-card-reveal stagger via inline animationDelay, and the 5-variant sprint grid (with hook/body/cta phone beats x5) all PASS. The iter8 markdown-bold beat-marker bug is also RESOLVED — the persisted sprint job renders 5/5/5 phone-beat-hook/body/cta. Live multi-platform 3-way parallel and fresh sprint generation were NOT run live (token budget), but the persisted sprint job already exercises the same render path end-to-end and the parallel-dispatch code (Promise.all on /scripts/shorts) is structurally sound.

critical_code_review_comments: Scripts.jsx is now ~1042 lines (still above the 700-line guideline despite previous extractions of AngleCard / SectionCard / ShortPhoneBody / SavedAnglesPanel / ScriptHistoryList / GenProgress / SprintResult). Recommend a follow-up extraction of: (a) the topic+settings step (TOPIC/ANGLES) into a ScriptInputsPanel, (b) the result header (Copy all / Cut into Short / Send to Studio) into a ResultHeader component, and (c) the multi-platform-status + platform-tabs strip into a PlatformTabsStrip. After that the page should be under 500 lines and easier to reason about.

kickoffGeneration's multi-platform branch fires 3 parallel POSTs but only sets one shared elapsed timer in pollMultiJobs. Consider per-platform elapsed timers (or per-platform 'done at' timestamps in the multiJobs entries) so the UI can show 'YouTube done in 32s · TikTok done in 41s' instead of one cumulative number. Minor UX polish, not blocking.

The sprint-opt-sprint button uses both setSprint(false) on the Single side and toggleSprint() on the Sprint side. The asymmetric handler is slightly surprising — toggleSprint() can flip the flag off if the user clicks the Sprint pill twice. Recommend changing it to an unconditional setSprint(true) + setMultiPlatform(false) for clarity; the Single pill already handles the off-case.

parseSprintVariants relies on the exact header '### 🎬 SPRINT VARIANT N — name' from Claude — any prompt drift (e.g. Claude using '##' or replacing the em-dash) silently produces zero variants and a blank sprint-grid. Suggest a defensive fallback in parser.js: if zero matches with the strict regex, retry with a relaxed /^#{2,3}\s*(?:🎬\s*)?SPRINT\s+VARIANT\s+(\d+)\s*[—\-:]/im pattern. Add a sample fixture to parser.test.cjs.

Per-section accent colors are defined as raw CSS in App.css keyed off [data-section]. The mapping (orange/lavender/red/blue/green/pink/cyan/amber) duplicates intent with SECTION_LABEL in SectionCard.jsx — consider co-locating both in a single SECTION_META object exported from /app/frontend/src/utils/parser.js (or a new sectionsMeta.js) so the color tokens can also be consumed by JS (e.g. by SavedAnglesPanel category pills which appear to use the same palette today).
